stories.title: FAA grounds all US departing flights after communications system outage
stories.line: The FAA halted departing flights at all US airports after a communications system outage, with no sign of a security attack so far.

stories.title: FAA grounds flights nationwide after telecommunications outage
stories.line: The FAA halted departing flights nationwide after a communications failure disrupted air traffic control; no restart time has been given.

stories.title: SpaceX aborts booster catch on Starship test flight; booster lost
stories.line: SpaceX's Starship test aborted an attempt to catch its booster with mechanical arms, and the booster was lost during the flight.

stories.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang out after intelligence ties to suspected Chinese spy
stories.line: Nvidia's CEO Jensen Huang resigned after intelligence reportedly tied him to a suspected Chinese spy, drawing Washington scrutiny of the company.

stories.title: UK police open sex offence investigation into comedian David Walliams
stories.line: UK police have opened a sex offence investigation into comedian David Walliams, who has not been charged.

stories.title: FAA orders nationwide ground stop, halting flights across the U.S.
stories.line: The FAA halted all U.S. flights nationwide in a rare ground stop, stranding travelers with no clear timeline.
